name: m+ Income Momentum Autocall ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that, under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in unfunded total return swaps (based on their notional value) that provide exposure to the S&P U.S. Equity Momentum 40% VT 4% Decrement Autocall Index (USD) ER (the “Autocall Index”). It is non-diversified.
